journey.name: ED-06 A failed save keeps the form and does not navigate
journey.description:
Covers FR-02 and the third of the editor's failure fields (REQUIREMENTS.md section 9, lines 243-248). A save that fails is a saveError: a snackbar over a form that is still intact, with isSaved never set, so the route does not navigate away. Nothing the user typed may be lost.
Contrast with ED-07, where the *load* fails and the form is replaced instead.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 # open the editor and fill it in first, then break the source before tapping Save adb shell am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 1.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Pay the invoice" into the "Title" field
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is on screen
Verify that the title "New task" is still on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Pay the invoice"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field still contains "Before Friday"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is still selected
